title: Stage mapping from change events

story.i_want_to: move a story's stage from its change's events
story.so_that: the stage machine reflects review, landing, deploy and revert without a PR stage

rationale: PRD §5 mapping table. Reuses the existing stages and adds control-only edges where the main line has none.

acceptance_criteria.description: submitted for ANY revision moves implementing to reviewing over :forward; review_findings moves reviewing to implementing over :review_findings; review_approved (by model or by policy) together with check_passed on the same revision moves reviewing to ci over a new control-only edge :change_ready; landed moves ci to merged over :forward with merge_sha set to the landing commit; deployed moves merged to deployed over :forward.
pr_open is never entered for a story on a :chg source. An event whose target stage is the row's current stage is recorded and applied as a no-op.
verified records trunk_verified_sha on the stage row and writes no edge.

A new control-only edge :reverted takes merged or deployed to implementing, keeping the claim. It is in @chained_edges, and clears/3 clears the merge- and head-keyed fields exactly as :merge_refused does.

reverted on a verified story escalates over a new control-only edge :reverted_after_verify. reverted on a done story leaves it done, appends the revert to its audit history, and opens a new intake issue on the repo carrying chg's failing tests fenced as untrusted text.

An event whose edge is not allowed from the row's current stage escalates over a new control-only edge :change_outside_lifecycle through Escalations.escalate_as_control/3, records the event, and never forces the stage.
None of the new edges appears in runner_transitions/0.

test_cases.name: two-round happy path
steps: apply submitted r1, review_findings, submitted r2, review_approved + check_passed r2, landed, deployed
expected_results: stages reviewing, implementing, reviewing, ci, merged, deployed

test_cases.name: policy auto-approval lands
steps: apply review_approved by policy + check_passed, then landed

test_cases.name: revert is a chained retraction
preconditions: a story at deployed with merge_sha set

technical_notes: For each new edge ask what writes the edge out of the stage it leaves stories in (the comment on absorbing stages in stage_machine.ex).
